title: Stress release via thermodynamic regulation towards efficient flexible perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4324-4334
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00342C, Paper
Zhiyang Xu, Runnan Yu, Tangyue Xue, Qiang Guo, Qianglong Lv, Chen Zhang, Erjun Zhou, Zhan’ao Tan
The residual strain in perovskite films was regulated by coordination and thermodynamic sublimation of camphor to achieve flexible perovskite solar cells with improved efficiency and mechanical properties.
